title: Interview with Minjee Kim, Online, 15 April 2025
authors: De Oliveira Tomás Estévez Torres, Carolina

contacts.name: De Oliveira Tomás Estévez Torres, Carolina

descriptions: Interview with Dr. Minjee Kim, historian and lecturer specializing in fashion, dress and textile history of Korea. The interview includes a brief overview of Traditional Korean Dress (Hanbok) history and style evolution across centuries, with a particular focus on the late Joseon period (late 19th century) for Master's thesis research.
